slides.title: What is a Prompt?
content: A prompt is your instruction to an AI.
Think of it as talking to a very smart, but literal assistant.
A good prompt guides the AI to give you exact results.
narration: Let us understand, what exactly is a 'prompt'?
A prompt is simply your instruction or question to an AI.
Imagine talking to a very clever assistant.
But this assistant does only what you say, very literally.
slides.image_prompt: A person clearly speaking into a microphone, with sound waves transforming into digital text or an AI assistant icon, simple and direct.

slides.title: Be Clear, Be Specific
content: The first rule: Don't make the AI guess!
State exactly what you want.
Example: 'Write something about cats.' (Weak)
Better: 'Write a short paragraph about owning a cat.' (Good)
narration: Our first principle is to be clear and specific.
Do not make the AI guess what you want.
For example, 'Write something about cats' is too vague.
A better prompt is, 'Write a short paragraph about owning a cat.'
This helps the AI focus its answer.
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass highlighting clear, concise text next to blurred, vague text, visually representing clarity versus ambiguity.

slides.title: Add Context and Role-Playing
content: Give the AI background information.
Tell the AI what role to play and its audience.
Example: 'Give me a recipe.' (Weak)
Better: 'Act as a friendly chef. Give me a simple, quick dinner recipe.'
narration: Next, add context and use role-playing.
Tell the AI about your situation.
Also, tell it who to be. For example, a chef.
A weak prompt is, 'Give me a recipe.'
A better prompt is, 'Act as a friendly chef.'
Then add, 'Give me a simple, quick dinner recipe.'
slides.image_prompt: A stylized AI assistant figure wearing different hats (e.g., chef's hat, teacher's cap) surrounded by contextual elements, showing persona and background.

slides.title: Set Constraints and Examples
content: Define format, length, and style.
Show, don't just tell, with examples.
Example: 'Write three bullet points, like this:'
'- Purr-Fect Companionship: Cats offer silent support...'
narration: Finally, set constraints and provide examples.
Specify the format, length, and style you want.
You can also give an example of the output you like.
For instance, 'Write three bullet points, like this example:'
'- Purr-Fect Companionship: Cats offer silent support...'
slides.image_prompt: A ruler and a pen defining a structured document, with a small example text box showing specific formatting, conveying boundaries and guidance.

slides.title: Key Takeaways
content: Be Clear & Specific: State exactly what you want.
Add Context: Give background information.
Role-Play: Tell the AI who to be and for whom.
Set Constraints: Define format, length, and style.
Iterate: Refine your prompts as a conversation.
narration: Let us recap the key takeaways from this tutorial.
First, be clear and specific in your prompt.
Second, add context so the AI understands your need.
Third, use role-playing to guide the AI's persona.
Fourth, set constraints like format and length.
Remember, prompting is a conversation, so iterate and refine.
slides.image_prompt: A simple checklist with tick marks, each point representing a key takeaway from prompt engineering, clean and easy to read.

slides.title: Assignment: Craft Your Prompt
content: Task: Plan a surprise birthday party for a friend who loves sci-fi.
Instructions:
1. Write a basic prompt for ideas.
2. Refine it: Add 'You are a party planner.'
3. Further refine: Specify 3 sci-fi themes, food, and activities as bullet points.
narration: Now for a small assignment to practice.
Imagine you need to plan a surprise party for a sci-fi loving friend.
First, write a basic prompt for party ideas.
Then, refine it by telling the AI to act as a party planner.
Finally, specify three sci-fi themes.
Also request food and activities, all in bullet points.
This will help you apply what you have learned today.
